metadata.title: Run Test Suite
metadata.purposeAndUsage: Execute test cases from an ADO test suite with assertions on HTTP responses, MongoDB state, SQS queues, S3 objects, and Coralogix logs. Handles AWS SSO authentication, captures evidence for each step, and generates a detailed test results report. Use as a standalone test execution process or as a sub-process within the SDLC orchestrator.

workItemId.description: Azure DevOps work item ID (used to resolve test suite if testSuiteId not provided)

testSuiteId.description: ADO test suite ID to execute (resolved from parent memory if not provided)

steps.name: Setup & Load Config
steps.output: Output directory created, config loaded, AWS session verified, environment confirmed

actions: Load app config-map for AWS service endpoints
Verify AWS SSO session (aws sts get-caller-identity)
Verify AWS account ID matches config
awsRules: All AWS CLI commands must include --profile and --region
Account mismatch = abort with clear error

steps.name: Fetch & Parse Test Cases
steps.output: Parsed test cases with step details (action, expected result, type)

guidance.parse: Extract Microsoft.VSTS.TCM.Steps XML. For each step: id, type (ActionStep/ValidateStep), action text, expected result.

steps.name: Execute Test Cases
steps.output: Test results with evidence JSON files for each step

guidance.evidenceRule: Save evidence JSON immediately after each step executes. NEVER generate evidence from memory or inference.
guidance.asyncRule: After SQS messages, wait 20-30s for consumer processing before verification.
guidance.perTestCase: Maintain test context dictionary for passing data between steps. Clear between test cases.

steps.name: Generate Results Report
steps.output: test-results.html + test-results.md with pass/fail summary, step details, evidence links

guidance.htmlReport: Dark theme, expandable test case cards, color-coded status badges, evidence links, precondition context panel
guidance.mdReport: Quick reference with pass/fail table, failed tests summary
guidance.evidenceIntegrity: MUST source evidence data from saved JSON files, NEVER from memory. If evidence file missing, mark as missing.
